grammar.summary: 本课学习表感知的 be aware of 与抽象名词化叙事。

points.title: be aware of/that 表意识
points.explanation: He is aware of the shape. aware of + 名词 / aware that + 从句：感知动词的两种搭配。

examples.en: The sculptor is fully aware of the form he is creating.
examples.cn: 雕塑家完全清楚自己正在创造的形体。

points.title: might well 表推测强化（复现）
points.explanation: Good sculpture might well be described as... might well + 被动 = 完全可以这样说。

examples.en: Sculpture might well be called the most difficult art.
examples.cn: 雕塑完全可以被称为最难的艺术。
